 Order
This petition is filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. praying to enlarge the petitioner-accused No.1, on bail in Crime No.35/2022 of Khanapur Police Station, Belagavi district.

2. Charge sheet has been laid against the accused Nos.1 to 4 for offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC, Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 9 and 10 the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.

3. Complaint is lodged by one Anuradha Vijaykumar Kurane, working as Anganawadi Supervisor in the office of Child Development Project office, Khanapur, Belagavi District alleging that petitioner herein has committed penetrative sexual assault on a minor girl aged about 14 years and married her on 31.01.2022 in Allam Prabhu Temple etc.
4. Accused No.2 is the mother of the victim girl and accused Nos.3 and 4 are the parents of accused No.1.
The statement of the victim has been recorded under Section 161 and Section 164 of Cr.P.C.

She has stated that accused/petitioner has committed penetrative sexual assault on her for about four times from 16.12.2021 and coming to know about the same, her marriage was performed with the petitioner on 31.01.2022 at Prabhudevara Gudi by her mother and parents of accused No.1.
5.
As per school certificate, date of birth of the victim is 23.08.2007.
As per medical examination report, her estimated dental age is 15-16 years and skeletal age is between 16-18 years.
6. The learned counsel for petitioner has disputed the age of the victim and contended that the age of the victim is not properly determined by the prosecution.
He would also rely on the medical examination report to contend that as per the said report, there was no signs of recent forcible sexual intercourse.

7. At this stage, there are sufficient materials collected by the prosecution to show that the victim Sri. Rudrayya S/O Shivayya Pujeri vs The State Of Karnataka on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126690900/
2 was a minor as on the date of commission of offence.
Further, the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. also shows that she was subjected to penetrative sexual assault by the petitioner.
Victim's evidence is yet to be recorded and therefore, there is possibility of influencing or threatening her by the petitioner in the event he is released on bail.
8. Petitioner was arrested on 08.05.2022.
Investigation is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Therefore, the learned Special Judge is directed to record the evidence of the victim girl as early as possible, keeping in view the relevant provisions of POCSO Act, 2012.
9. Liberty is reserved to the petitioner to file a fresh petition after victim's evidence is recorded.

With the above observations, petition is disposed of.
(Sd/-) JUDGE HMB Sri.
